sentences.text:
Author: Surepalli Nanda
Bench: Surepalli Nanda
 Hon'Ble Mrs Justice Surepalli Nanda
 Writ Petition No.7281 Of 2023
Order:

Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned Government Pleader for Revenue (Land Acquisition) appearing on behalf of respondents.1 to 3.
2.

The petitioners approached the Court seeking the prayer as follows:
"to issue an appropriate writ order or direction more particularly one in the nature of Writ of Mandamus, declaring the action of the Respondents more particularly the 3rd Respondent in not referring the application dated 20-04-2015 submitted by Petitioner Nos.1 and 2 under Sec.18 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 or Sec.64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and resettlement Act, 2013 to competent court or authority for fixation/
enhancement of compensation as arbitrary, illegal, and without jurisdiction and violative of Article 14 of the Constitution of India and consequently direct the Respondents to refer the application dated 20-04- 2015 to competent civil court or authority forthwith for fixation/ enhancement of compensation and pass such WP_7281_2023 SN,J further order or orders as this Hon'ble Court may deems fit and proper in the circumstances of the case."
3.

The case of the petitioners, in brief, as per the writ affidavit, is as follows:
a) The 1st petitioner is the owner and possessor of land admeasuring Ac.2-93 in Survey No.6 and the 2nd petitioner is the owner and possessor of land admeasuring Ac.3-04 Cts in Survey No. 86.

The said lands were acquired by the 3rd respondent vide draft notification dated 12.01.2012 for the purpose of formation of Package No.99, Right Main Canal Parmala Village of Gadwal Mandal and after issuance of declaration under Section 6 of the Land Acquisition Act passed an Award No.113/2014, dated 13.03.2015, vide file No.A2/112/2011 fixing compensation @
Rs.1,20,000/- per acre with all benefits under Land Acquisition Act, 1894.

sentences.text:
1 b) Petitioner Nos.1 and 2 were paid compensation vide cheques dated 13.03.2015 and received the compensation under protest as petitioner Nos.1 and 2 dissatisfied with the compensation amount awarded by the 3rd respondent and they submitted a common application dated 20.04.2015.
WP_7281_2023 SN,J c) The 3rd respondent did not take any action on the common application dated 20.04.2015 and had not referred the application submitted by the petitioner Nos.1 and 2, though their counsel reminded the 3rd respondent.

Petitioners came to know that the 3rd respondent forwarded the claim of the 3rd applicant only in the application dated 20.04.2015, which was referred to Civil Court and the same was numbered as O.P.No.31 of 2017 before the Senior Civil Judge, Gadwal and the said OP was answered on 26.02.2020 by enhancing the compensation and the 3rd respondent forwarded the claim of the 3rd applicant alone by ignoring the claim of petitioner Nos.1 and 2 for the reasons best known.
d) The Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and resettlement Act, 2013 came into force w.e.f. 01.01.2014, but in the present case, the Award was passed on 13.03.2015 after the New Act, 2013 came into force and the provisions of Section 24 of the Act, 2013 apply for the facts of the case of the petitioners for determination/fixation of compensation for the lands acquired.
e) The petitioners are still awaiting for the fair compensation for the lands which were acquired in the year WP_7281_2023 SN,J 2012.
The action of the 3rd respondent in not referring the application dated 20.04.2015 is arbitrary and illegal and therefore, the present writ petition is filed.

4. Learned Government Pleader appearing for respondent Nos.1 to 3 brings on record written instructions on behalf of the Special Deputy Collector (Land Acquisition), Jawahar Lift Irrigation Project, Gadwal, dated 04.03.2023, vide bearing No.A2/112/2011 and in particular, the relevant paragraphs of the said written instructions reads as under:
"Further the petitioners Sri.Ramachandra Reddy S/o Kurmi Reddy & (6) Others R/o Parumala Village of Gadwal Mandal have filed petitions U/s 18 of the Land Acquisition Act 1894 or section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and resettlement Act, 2013 to refer their matters competent Authority.

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the petitioners brings on record the information obtained under the Right to Information Act vide letter No.RTI/07/2022, dated 09.05.2023 and a bare perusal of the contents of the said letter dated 09.05.2023, clearly indicates the fact that application had been filed by the petitioners under Section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013read with Section 18 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, pertaining to determination of the correct market value to the petitioners subject property situated in the limits of Parmala Village, Gadwal Mandal, which were acquired for the formation of package No.99 Right Main Canal at Parmala Village since the Land Acquisition Officer had passed the Award determining incorrect market value.
6. Taking into consideration the fact that the application filed by the petitioners under Section 64 of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, read with Section 18 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, vide File No.A2/112/2011, dated 13.03.2015, on the file of the Land WP_7281_2023 SN,J Acquisition Officer and Special Deputy Collector (Land Acquisition), JLIP, Gadwal, had been acknowledged by the office of the Special Deputy Collector, Jawahar Lift Irrigation Project, Gadwal on 20.04.2015, the writ petition is disposed of directing the 3rd respondent to refer the application dated 13.03.2015 vide File No.A2/112/2011, submitted by the petitioners under Section 18 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 read with Section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, to the competent Court or Authority for determination of the correct Market value of the above said acquired property, within a period of three (03) weeks from the date of receipt of copy of this order.
